# Host configuration flags

::: warning `tools/hostcfg.py keys` is NOT a source of truth
It carries a separate, stale key table and reports keys the host demonstrably
reads as *"silently ignored; typo?"*. It also assumes every flag defaults
off, so it misreports every `readBoolKeyDef` flag (`forceOfflinePractice`,
for one, defaults **on**). This page is generated from the call sites instead.
:::
